name: SentinelAI behavioural anomaly detector
type: Unsupervised anomaly detection ensemble (trained only on normal behaviour)

algorithms.name: Robust Distance (median / MAD)
algorithms.role: Measures how extreme each value is

combination: ML risk = max(calibrated forest score, calibrated distance score); final risk = 1 - (1 - ML/100) x (1 - rules/100)

features.name: hours_outside_usual_window
features.description: Hours between the login time and the person's usual working window

features.name: unusual_weekend_login
features.description: 1 if a weekend login by someone who rarely works weekends

features.name: new_device
features.description: 1 if the OS/browser was never used by this person

features.name: new_country
features.description: 1 if this person never logged in from this country

features.name: new_city
features.description: 1 if this person never logged in from this city

features.name: travel_speed_log
features.description: log(1 + km/h) needed to travel from the last trusted session

features.name: failed_logins
features.description: Failed attempts before the successful login

features.name: download_ratio_log
features.description: log of files downloaded vs. this person's average

features.name: data_volume_ratio_log
features.description: log of MB downloaded vs. this person's average

features.name: api_ratio_log
features.description: log of API calls vs. this person's average

features.name: sensitive_ratio_log
features.description: log of sensitive records opened vs. this person's average

features.name: new_sensitive_systems
features.description: Number of sensitive systems opened for the first time

features.name: unfamiliar_admin_actions
features.description: Number of admin actions this person never performed before

limitations: Trained on synthetic data; accuracy on real enterprise logs will be lower.
A new employee has no twin yet, so early sessions are scored against defaults.
Twins follow drift only through low-risk sessions and analyst labels; a very slow, patient attacker could still shift a twin over many weeks.
